author: sheeham
quote: I might be the only one admitting this, but I feel a little disappointed with the game. I wouldn't say its worth the 13 years wait because of many bugs and glitches. For example Jason clipping through walls and other objects and falling of the map when colliding with cars. Not even the realistic graphics and animations can make up for this. Now some people may argue that the gake JUST released, but after how long exactly? Also rockstar really needs to do something about the young kids playing the game too, very concerning. Other than that its not too bad.

author: sheeham
quote: Super fun game and amazing story. Super fun sidequests, cutscenes and interesting plot twists. Truly a jump from the n64 version.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
